text:
ben: Noticed a surge in dropped frames and slow heatmap render in EU canary after yesterday's frontend deploy. Anyone else seeing LCP climb? :thinking:

maria: yep. LCP +75ms on average for first load. Heatmaps and sparklines worst. Saw an increase in parse+eval time.

hao: digging in bundle diffs 1: added pako (gzip inflate) to telemetry-client for compressed sampling payloads. telemetry-client chunk went from 1.4MB -> 1.75MB. That extra parse time plus sync init seems to be the culprit.

rachel: we also altered prefetch routing TTL in EU to 8s to reduce overfetch last night. That increases kvcache churn; cold tile fetches up 2x in traces. Combined with a heavier main bundle it's bad.

ben: flame trace snippet: 
```
ParseHTML 80ms -> Eval main 120ms -> TelemetryClient.init (sync) 160ms -> ChartRenderer.eval 50ms
Tile fetch latency 60ms (cold) x2 requests
```

maria: looks like the telemetry init is running before any idle time. Could we gate telemetry behind an idle callback or dynamic import?

hao: quick experiment: replaced sync require with requestIdleCallback + dynamic import in local build, dropped blocking time by ~140ms. Code: 
```
requestIdleCallback(() => import('./telemetry-client').then(m=>m.init()))
```
Works fine and keeps sampling warm.

rachel: for the routing TTL, I can revert EU prefetch TTL to 22s for canary to reduce KV evictions while we stabilize. That should cut cold tile requests.

ops-bot: NOTE: canary rollback window active until 6220000100. Open PRs before window close to trigger rollback.

ben: Proposed immediate actions: 1) revert pako change in canary (PR) or lazy-load it 2) revert EU prefetch TTL to 22s 3) add a temporary bundle-size budget check in CI to prevent large bumps 4) follow-up: telemetry feature-flag + opt-in sampling.

maria: I'll open the PR to lazy-load telemetry (and pako) behind requestIdleCallback. If CI budget fails we'll cut the pako change entirely.

hao: FYI the pako usage was to reduce network for telemetry ingestion (nice to have) but not worth blocking UX. We can server-side decompress for now.

rachel: rolling TTL revert now to eu-canary config. I'll post when live.

ops-bot: PR #3612 opened by maria: lazy-load telemetry + requestIdleCallback. Canary rollback queue updated.

ben: thanks. After the change, let's watch heatmap LCP, tile request rate, and KV miss. Post diffs here. :thumbsup:
